'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Matt Paragano LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Paragano]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Username:''' GunganStyle
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
